description: Mama -- Counterbalanced Forklift AGV, floor-to-floor pallet transport, 10 filling lines, 2000 kg max payload
notes: Greenfield F&B production. 10 filling lines, 2 warehouses, 1 staging area. Packaging supply + finished goods transport. All stations floor-level (floor delivery/picking). Required lift height ~200-400mm only (Boden-Boden). 3 pallet sizes: 800x1200, 1000x1200, 1200x1200. Max load 2000kg. 24/7 operation. Preferred suppliers: Jungheinrich (1st), Linde (2nd) -> Counterbalanced Forklift, NOT Mobile AMR. MES via OPC UA.
